lead: An interactive session beside the running loop cannot link `nvs-cli`, and the error names a file rather than a cause.
body: `cargo build` stops at `failed to remove file <repo>\target\debug\nvs.exe` / `os error 5` because Windows will not replace a running image and the loop's `.nvst` trees run one for minutes. `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='nvs.exe'"` shows it is live work — PIDs change between two calls — so retry rather than kill; the same collision fails `log::tests::the_engine_floor_rotates_and_rate_limits_itself` on a shared rotation path.
